title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S05 E01 — Breeding Ground
Bryce Johnson, Dr. Mireya Mayor and Russell Acord scour North America in search of the cryptid known as Bigfoot; they return to northern California to explore compelling evidence and unlock this centuries-old mystery.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S05 E02 — Nests of Giants
Deep in the Northern California wilderness, Russell stops at nothing to reach a nesting site; Mireya and Bryce uncover evidence that a family of Bigfoot is nearby; Ben speaks with a witness who had a chilling encounter with Bigfoot.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S05 E03 — The Watchers
Deep in Northern California's lost coast, an audio expert joins the fold after the team hears unusual sounds; Russell must take shelter from a storm; Bryce speaks with a local Hoopa Tribal Council member after reviewing illuminating footage.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S05 E04 — Primal Fear
Russell searches a rugged hillside full of caves in Northern California's forests; Bryce speaks with a witness who hears frightening grunts; Mireya and Tobe Johnson expand their search area to determine if Bigfoot is mimicking animal sounds.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S05 E05 — Watch Your Step
Russell discovers new sights and sounds deep in the backcountry of Northern California; Bryce talks with a witness who had an experience with a family of Bigfoot; Mireya reaches new heights in search of physical evidence of the elusive creature.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S05 E06 — Smells Like Bigfoot
In NorCal's backcountry, the team develops a clear plan of attack to lure Bigfoot out of hiding; Russell travels overnight, hoping to gather key evidence in their search; Mireya and Bryce conduct an investigation unlike any other.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S05 E07 — The Gathering Storm
The team's investigations converge as Bryce, Mireya and Russell discover tree structures on different sides of the same mountain; as a storm approaches, Bryce prepares an AI-powered surveillance array that will help pinpoint Bigfoot's location.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S05 E08 — Bigfoot's Doorstep
Bryce, Mireya and Russell converge at the center of their NorCal hot zone as a catastrophic storm threatens the expedition; armed with AI technology, they're ready to meet the elusive cryptid before it's too late; Russell spies signs of Bigfoot.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S06 E01 — Why Are They Here?
Months after the Northern California expedition, Bryce, Mireya, and Russell head to Washington after a fresh lead points to a target zone where Bigfoot groups are congregating for an unknown reason; Survivalist Biko Wright joins the hunt.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S06 E02 — Warning Signals
South of a Bigfoot chokepoint in Washington, Russell follows a trail of warning signs into the backcountry; Mireya and Biko track what could be a curious Bigfoot; Bryce speaks with a witness, who wishes he never laid eyes on the cryptid creature.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:

In the heart of The Fork, Russell is on the trail of a possible pair of Bigfoot; Mireya and Biko utilize cutting-edge tech to try and catch a base camp intruder as Bryce makes a startling find while reviewing footage.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:

Mireya and Biko navigate rapids while tracking a possible hunting party; Bryce gains knowledge from fresh prints; Russell creates a trap for Bigfoot.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:

In the heart of "The Fork," Biko howls into the night during a stakeout with Mireya; Bryce makes a surprising discovery at the cabin Russell has been occupying.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
